port.label: Port
port.description: UDP port for this sync zone. Use the same port in your WLED devices' audio sync settings.

latency_ms.label: Sync latency (ms)
latency_ms.description: Milliseconds to send audio-sync packets ahead of the audio, to offset the speaker's output latency. Increase if the lights lag the music.

gain_db.label: Gain (dB)
gain_db.description: Boosts the analysed audio before sending. Increase if effects look dim or flat, decrease if they are pinned at maximum.

scaling_mode.label: Scaling mode
scaling_mode.description: Perceptual curve applied to the audio levels, matching WLED's own FFT scaling options.

user.title: Add WLED sync zone
user.description: Pick the UDP port for this sync zone. Set the same port on your WLED devices in the AudioReactive sync settings.

manifest.description: Drive WLED's built-in audio-reactive effects from music played by Music Assistant.

errors.port_in_use: This zone port is already used by another WLED instance. Choose a different port.
